Now we added AgNO3, got pale yellow precipitate. Ag+ reacts with halides: AgCl (white), AgBr (pale yellow), AgI (yellow). Pale yellow suggests AgBr. So anion likely Br-.

Thus unknown salt likely KBr.

We should confirm with other tests maybe. Could also be KCl gives white precipitate. But we observed pale yellow, so Br.

We could test with Ba(NO3)2 to see if any precipitate (BaSO4 etc). But KBr would not precipitate with Ba2+. So mixing with Ba(NO3)2 should give no precipitate.

Let's do that small test.
